name: create-api-rest-with-zosconnect
description: Generates Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.0 contracts from COBOL copybooks with IBM z/OS Connect compatibility validation.

interface.shortDescription: Generate z/OS Connect OpenAPI contracts from copybooks
interface.longDescription: Generate Swagger 2.0 and OpenAPI 3.0 contracts from COBOL copybooks for IBM z/OS Connect. The skill parses copybooks, interviews the developer for endpoint details, maps COBOL fields to JSON schemas, applies documented z/OS Connect restrictions, validates the generated documents, and reports what still requires the target toolchain.
defaultPrompt: Generate a z/OS Connect OpenAPI 3.0 contract from these COBOL copybooks
Analyze this copybook and tell me which fields can map to JSON
Validate this Swagger 2.0 document for z/OS Connect compatibility
